description_en: Queries the details of the elastic plan for a cluster
description_zh: 查询集群的弹性计划详情
name: DescribeElasticPlanAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The name of the elastic plan.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601334.html operation to query the name of the elastic plan for the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601334.html接口查看集群的弹性计划名称
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

AutoScale.description_en:
Indicates whether proportional default elastic scaling for the storage acceleration service (EIU) is enabled.
Valid values:
true: Enabled. After this feature is enabled, storage resources scale in or out along with the elastic scaling of compute resources.
false: Disabled.
Only one storage elastic plan with proportional default elastic scaling for the storage acceleration service (EIU) can be enabled for the entire cluster. After this type of elastic plan is enabled, no other storage elastic plans can be enabled
AutoScale.description_zh:
是否启用存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性。
取值说明：
true：启用。启用后，存储资源会跟随计算资源的弹性伸缩而伸缩。
false：不启用。
整个集群只支持启用一个存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性的存储弹性计划，启用了此类型的弹性计划以后，无法再启用其他的存储弹性计划

CronExpression.description_en: The cron expression, which indicates the scaling cycle and scaling time of the elastic plan
CronExpression.description_zh: Cron表达式，表示弹性计划的变配周期和变配时间

ElasticPlanName.description_en: The name of the elastic plan

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the elastic plan is enabled

The end time.

The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
